report: Veda Spaces P0 architecture — remediation 01 validation

method.coverage: Substantive classification per requirement using the independent reviewer's taxonomy; the reviewer's matrix is the baseline. Classifications changed by remediation 01 are author assessments that require independent re-review. Navigation references are checked only for resolvability and are not coverage evidence (F-21).
method.tooling: Validation scripts were run in the authoring session and are intentionally not committed (no code in the architecture).
